scope: Grouped pixel-shift reconstruction and streamed NEFX serialization

implementation.reader: Each zero-based capture index is decoded once; at most four original source planes are retained.
implementation.repair: Independent groups of four preserve ordered sparse-repair dependencies.
implementation.pairs: Pair index j with j + input_count / 2, retaining the two-row displacement and ordered selected-sample overrides.
implementation.output: The cropped RGB array remains resident; exact NEFX verification compares 128-row blocks.
implementation.serialization: Packed14 RGB is emitted in 64-row blocks to the atomic temporary file. TIFF relocation uses seekable output with zero-filled gaps, avoiding full-output packing and serialization buffers.

saved_vendor_replay.note: Uses the uncorrected reference outputs from the radial corpus; radial correction is still disabled.

memory_measurement.evidence_kind: Scaled synthetic reconstruction in separate Linux processes; not a full-resolution end-to-end measurement

fixed_clock_baseline_comparison.provenance: Snapshot predates the final stream-position validation guard; report pins the exact implementation used. Final source hashes are covered by the native CLI and full-resolution checks below.

synthetic_writer_memory.limit: Separate processes, synthetic RGB with patched crop metadata; writer snapshot predates the final stream-position guard. RSS sampled before output decode.

full_resolution_resource_check.evidence_kind: Repeated ordinary RAW with synthetic 32-frame sequence metadata and empty repair selector
full_resolution_resource_check.limit: One measured run; no authentic capture, vendor full-resolution pixel comparison, or Lightroom acceptance is implied.

remaining: Final RGB allocation and LibRaw verification still scale with output dimensions.
